The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ -3 & -6 & 4 & -8 \\ 3 & 7 & -1 & 10\end{aligned}].
$$

Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ -3 & -6 & 4 & -8 \\ 3 & 7 & -1 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 3 & 7 & -1 & 10\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}-3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Note that we get ${a}_{22}=0.$ Therefore, we swap the $2$nd and $3$rd rows:

$$
\begin{aligned} & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -1 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

So, the system is now

$$
{\begin{aligned}x+2y-z=4 \\ y+2z=-2 \\ z=4,\end{aligned}
$$

and we can apply back substitution. The third equation $z=4$ tells us the value of $z.$ Substituting this value into the second equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}y+2(4)=-2\,⟹\,y=-10.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, substituting $y=-10$ and $z=4$ into the first equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}x+2(-10)-(4)=4\,⟹\,x=28.\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, the solution is $x=28$, $y=-10$, and $z=4.$
